Request a Consultation Memberships Financing Gift Cards Skincare Products Request a Consultation Request a Consultation Back Amanda Thomas, LE Master Esthetician Locations: Dover Amanda has been a Licensed Esthetician at Skin Health Medi-Spa since 2015, is certified in an array of medical modalities, and holds a Bachelor of Science degree from Plymouth State University in Psychology and Health. Amanda grew up locally in Durham, NH. She enjoys traveling, sailing on Lake Winnipesaukee, and exploring local breweries and wineries with her family and friends. Following her graduation from college in 2002, Amanda performed various roles in the banking industry and lived both abroad and in Hawaii for over 10 years.
